pageDescription: Add Nature Remo sensors and appliances to HomeKit.
tokenHelp: The token is stored in Homebridge configuration and sent directly from Homebridge to the Nature API during discovery.
ready: Enter an access token, then discover your devices.
cached: Showing saved device information ({count} Nature Remo device(s)). Discover again when needed.
discovering: Connecting to the Nature API and discovering devices…
complete: Discovered {count} Nature Remo device(s). Save and restart Homebridge.
timeout: Discovery did not complete within 30 seconds. Check the network connection.
remoHelp: Select Remo units whose sensors and appliances should be exposed. Clearing all selections disables every Remo.
includeHelp: Only checked appliances are controlled through HomeKit.
excludeHelp: Checked appliances are excluded; all others are controlled.
